mechanism: Tmem178 associates with STIM1 and is a negative modulator of STIM1 puncta formation in myeloid cells, limiting store-operated calcium entry
sentence: Here, we identified Tmem178 as a negative modulator of STIM1 puncta formation in myeloid cells.
justification: A brake on the first step of SOCE — puncta formation itself — in the myeloid lineage, which is also where the STING arm of this map lives.

mechanism: STIM1 interacts with filamin A on store depletion in human platelets; the STIM1 K684,685E mutant loses the interaction, as does an anti-FLNA (2597-2647) antibody
sentence: Our results demonstrate that STIM1 interacts with FLNA on calcium store depletion in human platelets.
justification: The cytoskeletal anchor of STIM1: where the sensor is held decides how much of it reaches the channel.

mechanism: silencing FLNA in platelets increases the association of STIM1 with the cytoskeleton, the STIM1-ORAI1 interaction and SOCE, and an anti-FLNA antibody enhances thrombin-induced aggregation
sentence: In platelets, attenuation of FLNA expression using siRNA resulted in enhanced association of STIM1 with the cytoskeleton, greater STIM1-Orai1 interaction, and SOCE.
justification: The functional sign of the filamin A contact: it fine-tunes SOCE downwards, and losing it makes platelets aggregate more.

mechanism: the microtubule-associated deacetylase HDAC6 regulates STIM1-mediated SOCE, differently in cervical cancer cells than in normal cervical epithelial cells; HDAC6 inhibition does not affect the STIM1-EB1 interaction
sentence: Here, we report that the microtubule-associated histone deacetylase 6 (HDAC6) differentially regulates activation of STIM1-mediated store-operated Ca(2+) entry (SOCE) between cervical cancer cells and normal cervical epithelial cells.
justification: A microtubule-side regulator of STIM1 whose effect flips between cancer and normal cells of the same tissue — a context dependence the map should carry.

mechanism: overexpression of CaMKIIdelta enhances thapsigargin-induced STIM1 co-localization and interaction with ORAI1 and increases SOCE, in HEK293 and HeLa cells
sentence: RESULTS: Overexpression of CaMKIIdelta enhanced TG-induced STIM1 co-localization and interaction with Orai1 as well as SOCE.
justification: A calcium effector feeding back on the sensor that produced the signal: CaMKII is a level-2 seed of this map, and this is the link to an anchor it needed to enter.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation in glomerular mesangial cells shows STIM1 bound to TRPC4 and not to TRPC1, while TRPC1/TRPC4 complexes form the functional store-operated channel
sentence: Co-immunoprecipitation showed that STIM1 interacted with TRPC4, but not TRPC1.
justification: A negative result worth carrying: in mesangial cells STIM1 reaches the TRPC1/TRPC4 channel through TRPC4, not through TRPC1, which is the opposite of the salivary-gland and platelet picture already in the map.

mechanism: co-immunoprecipitation of EFCAB13 with ORAI1 in platelets and megakaryoblastic cells, with co-localization increasing during thapsigargin-evoked SOCE; EFCAB13 is a positive regulator of SOCE and its effect is age-dependent
sentence: Coimmunoprecipitation experiments showed that EFCAB13 interacts with Orai1, and colocalization between both proteins increases during TG-evoked SOCE.
justification: A previously uncharacterized EF-hand protein on ORAI1, found in primary human platelets, whose contribution changes with donor age.
